checks.purpose: Independent check that zero laptop findings were not just a keyword-only rejection of ambiguous photo reviews.
checks.findings: Coordinator read the seven actual review containers that contain business-review-media images. Six explicitly describe refrigerators (purchase or repair); one describes plumbing work. There are no device-ambiguous text/photo candidates in these seven. No images from the general gallery were attributed to reviews. This check did not re-open the nine non-laptop originals and does not assert their detailed visual content.
